title: Unified dynamics of training, learning, inference, and reinforcement in neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.01345v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Through nine nanoGPT experiments, we established training-learning-inference relations: realized updates elicit state-dependent finite-amplitude responses; learning persistently reorganizes distributed functional support, with target-specific readout-boundary crossings determining capability transitions; inference recruits learned support without changing the learned state. Factors identified in the fifth experiment yielded a direct predictor of post-update capability transitions, achieving 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% four-way macro recall across 5,088 targets. We tested these relations and prediction across five additional neural architectures. In a seventh system, concentrated correct feedback eroded previously mastered skills; rebalanced feedback restored their accuracy from 70.31% to 99.48%. Linking inference consequences to subsequent training closes these relations into unified training-learning-inference-reinforcement dynamics.

translated_title: 神经网络中训练、学习、推理与强化的统一动力学
translated_abstract: 通过九项nanoGPT实验，我们建立了训练-学习-推理之间的关系：已实现的更新会引发依赖于状态的有限幅度响应；学习会持续重组分布式功能支持，其中特定目标的读出边界穿越决定了能力转变；推理会调用已学习的支持而不改变已学习的状态。在第五项实验中识别出的因素产生了一个直接预测更新后能力转变的预测器，在5,088个目标上达到了91.43%的准确率和91.49%的四分类宏观召回率。我们在另外五种神经架构上验证了这些关系和预测。在第七个系统中，集中的正确反馈侵蚀了先前已掌握的技能；而重新平衡的反馈将其准确率从70.31%恢复到99.48%。将推理的后果与后续训练联系起来，使这些关系闭合为统一的训练-学习-推理-强化动力学。
tldr: 该论文通过九项nanoGPT实验建立了训练、学习与推理间的定量关系，提出了预测更新后能力转变的直接预测器（准确率91.43%），发现重新平衡反馈可恢复被集中正确反馈侵蚀的技能，从而将三者闭合为统一的训练-学习-推理-强化动力学。
en_tdlr: Through nine nanoGPT experiments, this paper establishes training-learning-inference relations with a direct predictor of post-update capability transitions (91.43% accuracy), shows rebalanced feedback restores skills eroded by concentrated correct feedback, and closes these relations into unified training-learning-inference-reinforcement dynamics.
